function_declarations.name: resource-list
function_declarations.description: List all resources of a specific type from the ROM (rooms, sprites, dungeons, entrances, items, overlords)

function_declarations.name: resource-search
function_declarations.description: Search for resources by name or pattern

query.description: Search query or pattern to match

function_declarations.name: emulator-get-state
function_declarations.description: Retrieves the current state of the game from the emulator.

function_declarations.name: emulator-read-memory
function_declarations.description: Reads a block of memory from the SNES WRAM.

address.description: The memory address to read from (e.g., '0x7E0010').

length.description: The number of bytes to read.

function_declarations.name: emulator-write-memory
function_declarations.description: Writes a block of data to the SNES WRAM.

address.description: The memory address to write to.

data.description: The data to write, as a hex string (e.g., 'AABBCCDD').

function_declarations.name: emulator-reset
function_declarations.description: Reset the emulator to initial state (hard reset)

function_declarations.name: dungeon-list-sprites
function_declarations.description: List all sprites in a specific dungeon or room

function_declarations.name: dungeon-describe-room
function_declarations.description: Get detailed information about a specific dungeon room including sprites, chests, layout, and connections

function_declarations.name: overworld-find-tile
function_declarations.description: Find all locations where a specific tile16 ID appears in the overworld

tile.description: Tile16 ID to search for (hex format like '0x42' or decimal)

map.description: Specific overworld map to search (0-63, optional)

function_declarations.name: overworld-describe-map
function_declarations.description: Get detailed information about a specific overworld map including tile composition, warps, and sprites

function_declarations.name: overworld-list-warps
function_declarations.description: List all warp/entrance points for a specific overworld map

screen.description: Optional overworld screen ID filter (hex, e.g. 0x00)

function_declarations.name: overworld-list-sprites
function_declarations.description: List all sprites placed on a specific overworld map

screen.description: Optional overworld screen ID filter (hex, e.g. 0x00)

function_declarations.name: overworld-get-entrance
function_declarations.description: Get detailed information about a specific entrance/exit including destination and properties

function_declarations.name: overworld-tile-stats
function_declarations.description: Count tile16 usage per screen, per world and per tile16 id (most placed first)

map.description: Optional: one screen ID in hex (0x00-0x9F); omit for every screen

tile.description: Optional: tile16 ID in hex; adds its total and per-screen counts

top.description: Number of tile_counts entries to list (default 32, 0 = all)

function_declarations.name: dungeon-get-palette
function_declarations.description: Resolve a US/OOS room's full 8-bit palette-set ID to its shared global dungeon palette and list every affected room; unsupported regional layouts fail closed

index.description: Optional color index; omit to return all 90 colors

function_declarations.name: dungeon-set-palette-color
function_declarations.description: Dry-run or persist one US/OOS shared dungeon palette color with full palette-set, resolved-index, old-color, manifest, clean-file baseline, backup, atomic-save, and external-readback guards

index.description: Color index in the 90-color dungeon palette

expect-palette-index.description: Expected resolved global dungeon palette index

manifest.description: Hack Manifest path used to block protected ranges

write.description: Persist only after reviewing the default dry-run
